title: The Polite child at the table
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：polite　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 polite 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the counsellor wrote of ① a polite child at the table in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more polite than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the polite ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most polite child at the table anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too polite to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the polite ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a polite reply to the letter, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as polite as the reply to the letter they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was polite or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something polite, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite polite; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the polite ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another polite child at the table in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ more polite than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most polite reply to the letter in the whole garden, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the polite ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有礼貌（前置定语 a polite child at the table：1963 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件有礼貌的孩子）
B. adj. 有礼貌／客气（比较级 more polite than：文中两处，一处比饭桌上有礼貌的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有礼貌／客气（最高级 the most polite：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有礼貌（表语 too polite to do：母亲觉得它太有礼貌，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 客气（前置定语 a polite reply to the letter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩客气的回信）
F. adj. 客气（同级比较 as polite as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩客气的回信相比）
G. adj. 客气（后置定语 something polite：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 客气（受程度副词修饰 quite polite：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a polite child at the table
the most polite child at the table anybody
a polite reply to the letter
The most polite reply to the letter in

answers.why: polite 意为“有礼貌”，1963 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件有礼貌的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a polite child at the table。
polite 意为“有礼貌”，此处用比较级 more polite than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
polite 意为“有礼貌”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最有礼貌的一件，故用最高级 the most polite child at the table。
polite 意为“有礼貌”，母亲认为这件东西“太有礼貌了，谁也用不上”，too polite to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
polite 意为“客气”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩客气的回信”，此处作前置定语 a polite reply to the letter。
polite 意为“客气”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩客气的回信一样客气”，同级比较用 as polite as。
polite 意为“客气”，心记上那半行字要的是“客气的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something polite。
polite 意为“客气”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当客气”，quite 修饰原级 polite。
polite 意为“客气”，1973 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要客气”，故用比较级 more polite than。
polite 意为“客气”，母亲 1975 年说的是“整个小园里最客气的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most polite reply to the letter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件有礼貌的孩子。（a polite child at the table）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有礼貌。（more polite than …）
母亲觉得它太有礼貌，谁也用不上。（too polite to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩客气的回信。（a polite reply to the letter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩客气的回信一样客气。（as polite as …）
到了 1970 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件客气的东西。（something polite）
answers: In 1963 the counsellor wrote of a polite child at the table in the journal.
Everybody said it was more polite than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too polite to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a polite reply to the letter.
He said nobody would call it as polite as the reply to the letter they had once had.
By 1970 the journal asked for nothing but something polite.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 polite 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the counsellor wrote of a polite child at the table in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most polite child at the table in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too polite to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a polite reply to the letter, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite polite, and everybody laughed.
The polite ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
